research_question: Does Polymarket US currently publish a complete positive active liquidity-incentive population that pays a direction-independent resting-order score, and which one program has the highest prospectively defined reward-pool-per-hour-per-target-contract ratio for a later separate public competition screen?

official_sources.claim: The open Liquidity Incentive Program scores resting orders every second, whether or not they fill, using Discount Factor^(ticks from best price) times order size; each book side is normalized independently when Target Size is met, rewards are proportional, sub-one-dollar rewards are not paid, canceled or postponed games receive no rewards, and parameters may change.
Exchange-wide maker rebates equal 25 percent of taker fees at the point of trade under the published symmetric fee formula, separately from liquidity-program rewards.
GET /v1/incentives is public and unauthenticated and accepts pageSize, orderBy, orderDirection, and statuses filters while returning programs plus nextPageToken.

selection_rule: Admit every returned time period only when status is active, programType is liquidityProgram, the capture instant is within its explicit start-inclusive/end-exclusive interval, rewardPool and targetSize are finite and positive, discountFactor is finite in (0,1], and programId and marketSlug are nonempty. Require an explicitly empty nextPageToken and zero malformed rows; otherwise fail closed without pagination or a book request.
ranking_rule: Sort all admitted periods by descending rewardPool_USD divided by duration_hours divided by targetSize_contracts_per_side, then ascending marketSlug and programId. This ranking is frozen before program economics access and may nominate only a later separately frozen public book competition screen.
limitations: A public reward pool is not an owned payout floor; proportional score share can be zero.
The source does not prove account or jurisdiction eligibility, onboarding, capital availability, order permission, queue position, uptime, cancellation latency, or payout receipt.
Resting near the best price creates adverse-selection, inventory, hedge, fill, gap, cancellation, stale-quote, settlement, tax, and operating risks that can exceed rewards and maker rebates.
No volume, score, reward, or rebate may be manufactured through self-trading, wash trading, fake liquidity, spoofing, non-bona-fide orders, related accounts, manipulation, or program abuse.
A later public book snapshot can only reject or size a paper hypothesis; any order, account request, credential use, deposit, fund movement, or transaction requires explicit separate authority.
retry_policy: This exact current active first page is one-use. Preserve any HTTP, schema, phrase, pagination, malformed-row, or timing failure. Do not retry, change page size, paginate, alias the host, request earnings, use credentials, or select one observed program after failure. A passing result proves only a scoped public direction-independent reward mechanism and deterministic public book-screen candidate, never owned eligibility, fill quality, score share, recurrence, capacity, deployment readiness, or profit.
